CIRCUIT OPERATION
• When the power window switch is operated up or 
down, the power window motor operates and 
opens or closes the door window.
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION (COMMENT)
• The cause may be a malfunction of the power 
window motor <RH> drive circuit.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINTS
• Malfunction of the power window main switch
• Malfunction of the power window sub-switch
• Malfunction of the power window motor <RH>
• Damaged harness wires or connectors
